channel.title: SciPK Log — Parham Khodadi
channel.description: Notes on what I am building, what broke, and what I read.

item.title: Starting in GLACIER Lab
item.description: First weeks of M.S. research at UCLA: robust control for spacecraft rendezvous, under Prof. Shahriar Talebi. Reading through the uncertainty formulations before touching any code.

item.title: Senior Design Day: BAM avoided the ball
item.description: The multirotor detected, predicted, and evaded a thrown baseball in front of the judges. It never returned to its original trajectory on its own — that failure is the next problem to solve.

item.title: SciTech 2026: sixty-three years of a student branch
item.description: Our history of the AIAA student branch at San Diego State, founded in Spring 1963, is out. Interviews across six decades turned out to be harder than the writing.
